scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py runserver
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && uv --directory backend run mypy .
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend
scripts.schema:export: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py export_graphql_schema --output packages/api-client/schema.graphql && prettier --write packages/api-client/schema.graphql
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/schema.graphql packages/api-client/src/generated
scripts.backend:check: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py check
scripts.backend:migrations:check: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
scripts.compose:config: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml config --quiet && docker compose -f infra/compose.dev.yaml config --quiet && docker compose -f infra/compose.e2e.yaml config --quiet && DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=compose-validation-only POSTGRES_PASSWORD=compose-validation-only DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=tenda-app.com,www.tenda-app.com DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://tenda-app.com,https://www.tenda-app.com WEB_ORIGIN=https://tenda-app.com OUTBOX_ENCRYPTION_KEY=compose-outbox-key CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=compose-credential-key DJANGO_ADMIN_PATH=control-compose-check DJANGO_ADMIN_ALLOWED_NETWORKS=10.42.0.0/24 docker compose -f infra/compose.prod.yaml config --quiet
